items.title: Rashied Ali and Henry Grimes interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, January 30, 2009
items.q: I was just playing with them, like Gerry Mulligan and Lee Konitz and Dave Bailey, the drummer from —

ctx.x: No, no I’m talking about early on when you got into the jazz thing. It looks like you started recording like pretty actively, about once a month, around 1957.

Yeah I think Lee Konitz — I did some recording with him. But the rest of them, well they weren’t recording dates. I was just playing with them, like Gerry Mulligan and Lee Konitz and Dave Bailey, the drummer from —
